name: Triple vol-stress: VIX spike + crypto realized-vol spike + extreme fear (cross-market vol agreement)
rationale: Thesis: a forced-selling climax shows up as a vol spike in BOTH the equity-options market (vix_level) AND crypto's own realized vol (vol_realized), gauged independently, while sentiment (fear_greed) is at an extreme low. Requiring both vol gauges to spike together filters single-market vol noise (an equity-only VIX pop, or a crypto-only liquidation) down to genuine cross-market panic. All three are bounded levels used via gt/lt. Long-only spot, short hold to harvest the post-climax bounce. Disconfirmer: must beat (a) vol_realized-spike ALONE and (b) vix-spike ALONE on deflated Sharpe after fees — if either single vol gauge matches, requiring both vol markets plus sentiment over-fits a redundant vol axis. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: simultaneous VIX and crypto realized-vol spikes during extreme fear
